description: Ukrainian public-money payments from the State Treasury (spending.gov.ua, keyless): every treasury payment made BY a payer EDRPOU and/or TO a recipient EDRPOU in a date window of up to 92 days. Each row has transaction date, amount (UAH), payer name + EDRPOU, recipient name + EDRPOU, payment purpose text (Ukrainian), budget code, KEKV economic code, and the contract number when the Treasury recorded one. Returns totals and top counterparties across the whole window plus the newest `limit` rows. Use for: who a city council or ministry paid, which public bodies paid a supplier, and what for. Payments to private individuals arrive with the code masked by the Treasury. For payer->recipient pairs use ua_spend_between; to line payments up with ProZorro tenders use ua_spend_prozorro_link.

date_from.description: Window start, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days before date_to. Window may not exceed 92 days.

limit.description: Rows to return, newest first (1-500). Default 50. Totals always cover every row in the window.

payer_edrpou.description: Payer (spending body) EDRPOU code (8-digit Ukrainian legal-entity id; public bodies often 8 digits with leading zeros, e.g. "26510514" for Dnipro City Council). Several may be comma-separated.

purpose_contains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on the payment purpose text (Ukrainian, e.g. "харчування", "ремонт").

recipient_edrpou.description: Recipient (payee) EDRPOU code (8-digit Ukrainian legal-entity id; public bodies often 8 digits with leading zeros, e.g. "26510514" for Dnipro City Council). Several may be comma-separated.

name: ua_spend_payments
title: Ua Spend Payments
